title: SIGAN: A Novel Image Generation Method for Solar Cell Defect Segmentation and Augmentation
mechanism: GAN removes the defect while a strong identity loss keeps the background; the difference with the input segments the defect; also used to augment small defect sets.
adaptation: Generate defect-free twins of cracked train cells; use the residual (input minus twin) as an extra input channel or the twins as paired negatives to suppress decoys (scuffs, grain boundaries).
min_experiment: Arm: PF with residual channel, 5 seeds. Baseline: PF 5 seeds. Metric: test crack IoU clean 49 and E1 relF1@2. Kill: gain < +0.01 on both.
evidence: R: 90.34% F-score for crack and finger-interruption segmentation on EL-2019 (EL images).
